Microsoft Rocketbox Avatar Library - subset used by Sort or Stay
Source: https://github.com/microsoft/Microsoft-Rocketbox  (MIT licence, see LICENSE.md)

Characters/Male_Adult_10    player "Alex"  (hipoly, 81 bones)
Characters/Female_Adult_04  player "Maya"
  Textures were converted from the original TGA files: colour maps to JPG (2048),
  normal maps to PNG (1024), hair/eyelash opacity maps to PNG with alpha.

Animations/  (3ds Max biped clips, Generic rig, root node Bip01)
  m_/f_ idle_neutral_01, walk_neutral_01, run_neutral_01      locomotion
  m_/f_ cheer_01                                             level solved
  m_/f_ idle_scratch_head_01                                  wrong move
  m_/f_ try_door_outwards                                     locked door
  m_/f_ idle_look_around_01                                   intro

Import settings are applied by Assets/SortOrStay/Editor/RocketboxImport.cs (only for this folder).
Materials and the Animator controllers are generated by  Sort or Stay > Setup Player Characters (re-import).
